visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a gray t-shirt and dark trousers unfolds a large, off-white camping tent across a lush green lawn. In the background, two small wooden cabins with white doors are nestled among tall, leafy deciduous trees under bright natural daylight. (2) The camera pans upwards to show the dense green canopy of the trees swaying slightly, then cuts to a wider view of the campsite where another person carries equipment near a park bench. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the black 'Coleman' logo printed on the white tent fabric, which is laid flat on the grass. (4) The scene shifts to a setup campsite with a portable gray table holding a Marshall speaker, a laptop, and a silver mug. In the background, people are seen working on various tents under the shade of trees. (5) A man in a light green t-shirt enters the open flap of a large white tent, adjusting the interior support poles while the 'Coleman Darkroom Technology' slogan is visible on the exterior. (6) A young boy in a yellow t-shirt and tan pants kneels on the grass, using a heavy hammer to drive a metal tent stake into the earth. (7) A sequence of fast cuts shows the arrangement of camping furniture, including a tan foldable chair, white storage crates used as tables, and various bags placed on a black mesh ground mat. (8) The camera captures the interior of a white SUV trunk that has been converted into a sleeping area with a large mattress, a checkered pillow, and a tan duvet. (9) A close-up reveals a portable white gas stove with a kettle on top, placed on a folding table next to a digital tablet displaying video content. (10) A man in khaki pants and a brown shirt stands near a metal fire pit, using a small hatchet to split logs into kindling as orange flames flicker inside the pit. (11) A boy in a yellow shirt lies back on a large blue inflatable air lounger, laughing and clapping his hands while two other young people sit nearby on the grass. (12) A woman with brown hair tied back in a clip, wearing a white hoodie, sits inside a tent and adjusts a white camera mounted on a tripod to film her cooking process. (13) Close-up shots show a stainless steel pot on a Dr.Hows portable stove; a hand places a glass lid on the pot as steam begins to rise. (14) The final sequence features the hotpot cooking, showing layers of cabbage, sausages, corn, and thin slices of meat being stirred with wooden chopsticks as the sun sets, followed by a shot of the fire pit glowing brightly in the evening.
